correctness.rationale: For y^3=x(x-1)(x-a)(x-b) over algebraic closure of F5, with distinct branch values and ordered U, reconstruct the basis (dx/y, dx/y², x dx/y²) and 5th-root-semilinear Cartier cycle. Exact GF(5) coefficient extraction yields c4=-2t²(t+s), c9=-(s-1)(s²+t-1), d=-(s+1), and H=c4+c9 d^5. Thus stable Cartier rank is exactly 0 when H=0, exactly 2 otherwise; matrix rank 2 for all U gives a-number 1. The displayed Groebner basis for (H,H_s,H_t) has possible singularities (1,0),(-1,0),(3,2) only outside U, and (a,b)->(s,t) is etale when a!=b. A cubic-in-t polynomial root exclusion over F5bar(s) proves H irreducible; at a place above infinity t has pole order 3 while s²+t has odd pole order 3, so ordered discriminant is nonsquare and the ordered double cover stays irreducible. The point s=-1,t=1 lies inside U and H=0. No Newton polygon or moduli quotient claim is made.
